text: Ironvale Athletic exploited Redmond Rovers' high defensive line and aggressive pressing by launching a swift counter-attack following a foul near midfield. Their well-practiced vertical passing sequence, involving three quick passes over 12 seconds, dismantled the Rovers' structure and created a high-quality chance finished by Jonah Lindqvist at close range [#1153] [#1154] [#1155] [#1156] [#1157]. Redmond's vulnerability to counter-attacks against a team employing a low block and direct style was evident in this moment. The key coaching takeaway: when playing a high line against a counter-attacking side like Ironvale, reinforce quicker recovery runs and focus on cutting passing lanes behind the defense to reduce exposure.
